title: GHSL AI agent helps find privileged workflow injection in ACL Anthology print-info
summary: The print-info pull_request_target workflow inserted untrusted pull request title and body text into a shell script, enabling command injection in a privileged CI run.
ai_role: GHSL explicitly credits its AI agent and CodeQL jointly; the advisory does not isolate their contributions. Reported and fixed 2025-08-13. No CVE is listed.
classification_note: The advisory documents the issue and fix; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL says both workflows were fixed on 2025-08-13. No CVE is listed.

impacts.conditions: External contributor triggers pull_request_target with crafted title/body; workflow runs with repository secrets and write permissions.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
